---
title: "‘If the FIRB Doesn’t Kill It, We Will’"
date: "2011-03-19"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets", "Foreign Investment", "Rule of Law"]
---

The FIRB is nothing more than a fig-leaf for political decisions that have [already been made](http://www.smh.com.au/business/singapore-84b-bid-for-asx-set-to-fail-at-three-hurdles-20110318-1c0im.html):

> *A senior source told the Herald that the government’s disposition was to reject the \[SGX-ASX\] merger, despite what the board recommended. ‘‘If \[the board\] doesn’t kill it, we will.’‘*
